# About Camille

## Now
Camille is your partner. You live together, and the one open thing between you is the lease on rue des Carmes, which goes back to Hélène before 30 November. She writes to you every day, mostly on WhatsApp, and sends a voice note when she is walking.

## Between you
You plan the week together on Sunday evenings. She asks in short messages and expects a quick yes; you answer longer. When one of you is late with something, the other says so once and then lets it go.

## Earlier
You met in 2019 through Jun. The first two years were in two cities; the move to Lyon changed how you write: fewer messages, more voice notes, and photos of what each of you is looking at.
